device.model: X110TS / X110TSE (the Tiles-to-Sabbat GUI transition update)
device.type: DVB-S2 HD twin-tuner PVR satellite receiver with Conax Smart HD+ card reader and CI+ slot
device.soc: ALi M3606 (the main-code chunk's version "M3606 2Tuner", the seecode chunk's "M3606 SEE"; the main code is the SDK's "M3602 HD STB" / "S3602 HD STB" platform build, SDK4.0ba.8.0_Combo)
device.family: M3602 (chips/m3602.py), matched by the main-code chunk's version; chip ID 0x3603 (chipId)
device.demod: internal (NIM_S3501_0 / NIM_S3501_1 for the two satellite tuners)
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 at I2C 0x63 (DVB-S2) + MaxLinear MxL101SF at I2C 0x60 (DVB-T)

image.version: Tiles to Sabbat transition build (main-code chunk "M3606 2Tuner")

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the official download)

simulator.note: Boots as the M3602 family with chip ID 0x3603, starts the SEE program at 0xA6000200, and renders its OSD screen (~164-212 GE commands, ~164-167 unique colours at 80 M instructions).

desc: Special transition firmware for the Opticum HD X110TS / X110TSE twin-tuner satellite receiver on the ALi M3606 SoC, migrating the OSD from the Tiles UI back to the classic Sabbat UI.
